verdict.rationale: USCIS runs a developer platform (Torch) with a Case Status API and a FOIA Request API, plus a sandbox and production keys, so the versioning and deprecation axis applies. However, no evidence mentions API version identifiers, versioning scheme, deprecation timelines, or a published deprecation policy. Sandbox and onboarding docs are adjacent features and do not establish versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
